from PIL import Image,ImageFilter
import numpy as np
for p in ['outputs/v0/assets/mori_clay_texture.png','outputs/v1/assets/mori_fine_grain_clay_paper.png']:
 im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
 small=im.resize((32,48),Image.Resampling.BOX)
 a=np.asarray(small).astype(float)
 lum=a@np.array([0.2126,0.7152,0.0722])
 blur=np.asarray(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(4))).astype(float)
 full=np.asarray(im).astype(float)
 print(p)
 print('mean',full.mean(axis=(0,1)))
 print('macro_luma_std',lum.std(),'macro_rgb_stdmean',a.std(axis=(0,1)).mean(),'macro_luma_range',np.percentile(lum,95)-np.percentile(lum,5))
 print('micro_resid_std', (full-blur).std())
PY"
